exceptions.reachability: Rechecked on 2026-10-04: glib 0.18.5 is inherited by the Linux Tauri GTK stack and absent from the macOS and Windows release dependency graphs. AntennaBench has no direct VariantStr or VariantStrIter calls, but framework reachability cannot be excluded.
exceptions.rationale: The 2026-10-04 review confirmed RustSec still requires glib >=0.20.0. glib 0.18.5 remains the newest published 0.18 release, and current Tauri 2.12.1 still requires GTK 0.18. A supported compatible upgrade or published backport is unavailable. A local glib backport would require separately maintained vendored source and source-aware security review rather than a supported dependency upgrade.
exceptions.mitigation: Avoid the affected iterator API, retain Linux CI coverage, and track a supported Tauri or GTK upgrade in issue 83. Recheck upstream before 2026-11-03; the renewed exception remains scoped to glib 0.18.5 and does not waive any other advisory or release gate.

exceptions.reachability: The CA-root data is compiled into the desktop application through reqwest and hyper-rustls for both the optional NOAA propagation adapter and WSPR.live HTTPS acquisition.
exceptions.rationale: This is the only locked license outside the general allowlist. The exact crate and version remain narrow while release verification requires the reviewed agreement text in every packaged application.
exceptions.mitigation: Issue 82 records owner review. Both macOS application bundles include the complete upstream agreement and attribution in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt, and the release inspector rejects missing or altered notice bytes.
